cancer.label: Cancer / uncontrolled cell growth demo
cancer.description: A simplified demo disease model focused on loss of tumor suppression, DNA damage response, apoptosis, and abnormal clonal expansion.

neurodegeneration.label: Neurodegeneration demo
neurodegeneration.description: A simplified demo disease model focused on neuronal stress, inflammation, protein handling, and microglial activation.

TP53.name: tumor protein p53
TP53.function_summary: A transcription factor that responds to DNA damage and cellular stress by activating genes involved in cell cycle arrest, DNA repair, senescence, or apoptosis.
TP53.dna_concept: The TP53 gene contains DNA instructions for making p53 protein. When stress occurs, cells increase p53 signaling so damaged cells pause, repair, or die.
TP53.rna_concept: TP53 DNA can be transcribed into TP53 mRNA. That mRNA is translated by ribosomes into the p53 amino acid chain.

MDM2.name: MDM2 proto-oncogene
MDM2.function_summary: An E3 ubiquitin ligase that suppresses p53 by marking it for degradation. It participates in a feedback loop with p53.

CDKN1A.name: cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor 1A / p21
CDKN1A.function_summary: A p53 target gene that helps stop the cell cycle after DNA damage.

BAX.name: BCL2-associated X protein
BAX.function_summary: A pro-apoptotic protein that helps trigger programmed cell death when damage is severe.

ATM.name: ATM serine/threonine kinase
ATM.function_summary: A kinase that senses DNA double-strand breaks and helps activate p53-mediated damage response.

BRCA1.name: BRCA1 DNA repair associated
BRCA1.function_summary: A DNA repair protein that preserves genome stability and helps coordinate cell cycle checkpoints after damage.

BRCA2.name: BRCA2 DNA repair associated
BRCA2.function_summary: A homologous recombination repair protein that helps maintain chromosome integrity.

KRAS.name: KRAS proto-oncogene
KRAS.function_summary: A small GTPase that transmits growth signals from receptors to downstream proliferative pathways.

EGFR.name: epidermal growth factor receptor
EGFR.function_summary: A receptor tyrosine kinase that promotes proliferation and survival when activated.

PTEN.name: PTEN phosphatase
PTEN.function_summary: A tumor suppressor phosphatase that restrains PI3K-AKT signaling and limits growth.

p.R175H.biological_interpretation: Arginine at position 175 is in the p53 DNA-binding domain. Replacing it with histidine is modeled as reducing DNA-binding and tumor-suppressor transcriptional activity.

p.R273H.biological_interpretation: Arginine at position 273 is modeled as important for DNA contact. Mutation weakens sequence-specific DNA binding while leaving some structural stability.

loss_of_function.biological_interpretation: A generic knockout-like TP53 loss-of-function state used for simulation when no precise variant is specified.

p53_damage_response.label: p53 DNA damage response pathway
p53_damage_response.description: A simplified pathway model for p53 activation after DNA damage, leading to cell cycle arrest, DNA repair, apoptosis, and negative feedback through MDM2.
